name: Renton
seo_title: 5 Christmas Events for Kids in Renton, WA 2026
seo_desc: 5 Christmas events for kids in Renton, WA, 4 free: Museum Tree Lighting at Renton History Museum and more.
lede: Renton's holiday season centers on Lake Washington, where Clam Lights glows every night at Gene Coulon Memorial Beach Park, with a downtown tree lighting, free Santa photos and a police light show filling in the rest of December.
celebrates: The season starts downtown with the Museum Tree Lighting at the Renton History Museum, hosted by Renton Parks and Recreation and the Renton Historical Society on Small Business Saturday. A week later the city switches on Clam Lights, its signature waterfront light display at Gene Coulon Memorial Beach Park, with Santa, a singalong, the Rainier Yacht Club's Parade of Boats and a visit from the Argosy Christmas Ship on opening night. Santa House offers free photos at the Renton Civic Theatre on Saturdays, the Renton Police Department's Battle of the Badges fills Renton Technical College with decorated public safety vehicles, and Evergreen City Ballet dances The Nutcracker at the IKEA Performing Arts Center.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Renton lit the Renton History Museum tree on Saturday, November 29, from 5 to 6:30 pm. Clam Lights Opening Night followed on Friday, December 5, with festivities from 6:15 to 8:30 pm, and the lights then glowed nightly from 5 to 9 pm, December 6 through January 4. Battle of the Badges came to Renton Technical College on December 6, where Kent Police took the top trophy with its Merry Minions display. The Renton City Concert Band played a holiday concert on December 14 at the IKEA Performing Arts Center.
facts: Renton is named for Captain William Renton, a wealthy lumber and shipping investor. When Erasmus Smithers and his partners found coal here in 1873, Renton backed the venture, and they agreed to name the mine and the planned town after him. The city incorporated in 1901. Boeing arrived in 1941, and during World War II its Renton plant built B-29 bombers at up to six a day. Since 1967 the plant has assembled the 737.
trains: Renton grew up around rails. The Seattle and Walla Walla Railroad reached town in 1877, and an electric streetcar ran from Seattle to Renton from 1891 to 1936 on a route that later became Rainier Avenue. Today the closest passenger trains stop at Tukwila Station, 7301 Longacres Way, served by Sounder commuter trains and Amtrak Cascades. Kids may also spot 737 fuselages, built in Kansas, rolling through town by rail on their way to the Boeing plant. For a holiday train ride, the Northwest Railway Museum in Snoqualmie runs the North Pole Limited.
train_links: The 1890 Snoqualmie Depot, weekend train rides on 5.5 miles of track and the North Pole Limited Santa train.
A two minute ride on the original 1962 World's Fair trains between Westlake Center and Seattle Center.
The largest permanent model railroad in Washington and a holiday Model Train Festival in Tacoma.
traditions: Renton's signature waterfront light display glows along Lake Washington every night from early December into the new year.
The evergreen outside the Renton History Museum lights up on Small Business Saturday, with cocoa, cider and ornament kits for kids.
On Clam Lights opening night the Argosy Christmas Ship visits Gene Coulon Park right after the Rainier Yacht Club's Parade of Boats.
Police, fire and other public safety agencies decorate their vehicles, and visitors vote for the brightest display at Renton Technical College.
Santa poses for free photos at the Renton Civic Theatre on the first three Saturdays of December, and pets are welcome.
Evergreen City Ballet, based downtown on Bronson Way, dances Wade Walthall's The Nutcracker at the IKEA Performing Arts Center.
kidfact: The lakeside park where Clam Lights shines was once the end of a railroad line. Trains carried coal and lumber there to load onto waiting ships.
faq: When is Clam Lights in Renton?

Clam Lights opens with a free celebration on the first Friday evening of December at Gene Coulon Memorial Beach Park, 1201 Lake Washington Blvd N. Santa arrives and the lights switch on at 6:15 pm. After opening night the display stays lit every evening into early January. The City of Renton runs it, and Ivar's sponsors the season.
Where can kids see Santa in Renton?

Santa arrives at Gene Coulon Memorial Beach Park on Clam Lights opening night and poses for photos afterward. Downtown, Santa House offers free photos with Santa at the Renton Civic Theatre, 507 South 3rd Street, on the first three Saturday afternoons of December, sponsored by Caffee Accident and Injury Lawyers. Pets are welcome in the Santa House photos too.
What is Battle of the Badges in Renton?

It is a holiday light competition run by the Renton Police Department at Renton Technical College. Public safety agencies from around the region, from local police and fire departments to the Washington State Patrol, cover their vehicles in lights. Visitors walk through, enjoy music and food trucks, and vote for awards like the Clark Griswold Award. Entry is free.
Is there a Nutcracker in Renton?

Yes. Evergreen City Ballet, a ballet school in downtown Renton, performs Wade Walthall's The Nutcracker at the Renton IKEA Performing Arts Center, 400 South 2nd Street, each December. The Saturday matinee is a one hour version aimed at young children, and lap children 3 and under do not need a ticket.
Where is the Renton tree lighting?

The Museum Tree Lighting takes place outside the Renton History Museum, 235 Mill Avenue South, on the Saturday after Thanksgiving. Renton Parks and Recreation and the Renton Historical Society serve free cocoa and cider, and the first 75 children receive an ornament kit. Free downtown parking is nearby.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Renton for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Museum Tree Lighting at Renton History Museum) through January 3, with Museum Tree Lighting at Renton History Museum (November 28), Clam Lights at Gene Coulon Memorial Beach Park (from December 4) and Santa House at Renton Civic Theatre (from December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Renton families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.
